::: {#exr-fibonacci}
## How fast do the ratios converge?

The file `data/fibonacci.csv` contains the first $30$ Fibonacci numbers $F_n$.

1. Implement the function `fibonacci_ratios(F)`, which returns the ratios $q_n = F_{n+1} / F_n$ from
   @exr-golden-ratio for a vector `F` of Fibonacci numbers. Test it with $F_1, \ldots, F_6$.

1. Add the columns `q` and `error` to the data frame `fibonacci`: the ratio $q_n$, and its distance to the golden
   ratio. By which factor does the error fall in each step?

::: {.lm-scaffold}
```{r}
fibonacci_ratios <- function(F) {
  # ...
}
```
:::

::: {.lm-solution}
```{r}
fibonacci_ratios <- function(F) {
  F[-1] / F[-length(F)]
}

fibonacci_ratios(c(1, 1, 2, 3, 5, 8))
```

```{r}
fibonacci$q <- c(fibonacci_ratios(fibonacci$F), NA)
fibonacci$error <- abs(fibonacci$q - (1 + sqrt(5)) / 2)
head(fibonacci, 20)
```

The error falls by the factor $\varphi^2 \approx 2.6$ in each step: the ratios lie alternately above and below
$\varphi$, closer each time.
:::
:::
